text:
rachel-partnerships: Heads up — legal asked for a sample-data + data retention doc for the Snow/DBX connector certification. Need sign-off before we submit the marketplace listing. Who can own the artifacts and tests?

jasper-engineering: I can draft the ingestion schema and mapping README. Also need clarity on PII redaction rules. @lisa-legal can you confirm which fields to drop or pseudonymize?

lisa-legal: Prefer the minimal whitelist approach for the sample dataset: remove SSN, credit_card, gov_id fields. No real customer data in any artifact. We also need a short DPA snippet and a retention TTL (recommended 30 days for staging samples). I'll upload a DPA template to /legal today.

priya-ml: For vector DB verification we need deterministic embeddings. I'll generate a synthetic dataset with 2k rows and fixed RNG seeds, plus a small 100-row smoke CSV. I'll include a seed list and an example cosine baseline.

sam-qa: QA asks for a staging Snow account and a Delta table with 100 rows for smoke and 2k rows for perf. Need service account creds + allowed IP CIDR for the connector runner. Also confirm whether we should run with async batching off for the baseline.

rachel-partnerships: Action items: jasper -> schema + ingestion README by Fri EOD; priya -> synthetic datasets + embed seeds by Thu; sam -> staging creds + run smoke + perf tests; lisa -> sign off on DPA snippet by Fri. Legal explicitly: no real customer data in marketplace artifacts or demo. Reply here when you pick up items.

jasper-engineering: :thumbsup: will include a docker command for local ingest in the README and a minimal mapping example. Example local run: 
```
docker run --rm -e SNOW_CONN="user:pass@acct.snowflakecomputing.com" redwood/connector-snow:latest \n  --table demo.public.redwood_test --sample 100
```

sam-qa: Quick question — for perf we should test both batched and unbatched paths. Perf team prefers metrics for token/sec and p50/p95 latency for each mode. Do we have a perf harness?

priya-ml: Yes, test both. I'll provide an embeddings baseline CSV (id, text, seed, embedding) and a script to recompute embeddings with fixed seeds. I'll attach to the GH PR.

compliance-bot: New doc created: /legal/dpa/snow-connector-dpa-draft-v1.md

lisa-legal: I'll review DPA v1 tomorrow morning and leave comments in the doc. If small edits only, I can sign-off by Fri.

rachel-partnerships: Ping @mike-ops for marketplace listing window — ops, can we aim for next Tue if legal signs off by Fri?

mike-ops: Next Tue is tight but doable if artifacts + test results land by EOD Fri. I'll tentatively reserve the marketplace slot and drop the publishing checklist here by EOD today.

deploy-bot: CI: build 4532 passed for redwood/connector-snow branch=snow-cert (artifacts: connector-snow:4532)

sam-qa: I'll start the smoke run tonight against the staging creds once jasper shares the table name.

rachel-partnerships: :raised_hands: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the preflight. Please update when tasks are picked up or done.
